name: Caerulescent-Hypostyle
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the east, impact-scarred wastelands. Nothing wears any of it smooth.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Established during the last boom, the research outpost was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
